title: Undisclosed corner cell J26 requirement and strips of TABLE() formulas during recalculation
evidence: In the input workbook `14_02_Refinery_input.xlsx`, the sensitivity table grid `DCF_Income Approach!K27:O31` is already populated with `=TABLE($J$26,$C$18,$J27,$C$21,K$26)` formulas, while `J26` is blank. However, `recalculate_xlsx` in `libreoffice.py` calls `freeze_datatable_formulas(patched_input)` before invoking LibreOffice, which deletes all `<f>` elements starting with `TABLE(`. Consequently, if an agent links `J26` (`=D29`) using `openpyxl` without also pre-populating cached values in `K27:O31`, the verifier strips the `TABLE(...)` formulas before recalculation and grades `K27:O31` as `None`. Conversely, if an agent writes explicit sensitivity formulas into `K27:O31` (as Unit 3 did), leaving the unlabelled helper cell `J26` blank, the verifier flags `Modification error at DCF_Income Approach!J26: answer=28810.1725164556, output=None`.
confirmation: Input J26 is blank and K27:O31 already hold TABLE() formulas. The golden expects J26 '=D29'=28810.17, and the verifier's freeze_datatable_formulas strips TABLE formulas before recalculation. fix: prompt.md: the DCF sentence now says the table links Equity Value 'via the table's corner cell J26', disclosing the GT's J26 =D29. Together with the grid fix, explicit grid formulas plus J26 pass (local check: input + GT formulas + explicit grid values scores mod 1.0, reg 1.0 outside 'Amortization with extra payment', which fails locally even on the raw input under LibreOffice 26.8 but not in prod runs). title: Broken golden workbook and verifier comparison on floating-point zero residuals in untouched NCD and TL sheets
evidence: The sole verifier `SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check` (`weight: 1`) compares `untouched_input_14_02_Refinery_input.xlsx` and `gt_14_Refinery_golden.xlsx` across 43 sheets, classifying 2,240 cells as modification cells. However, 1,664 of those 2,240 modification cells (74.3%) are in the untouched debt-amortization sheets `NCD` (776 cells) and `TL` (888 cells), which have zero dependency on the three sheets the task edits (`Fixed Asset & Depreciation`, `WACC`, `DCF_Income Approach`). In those cells (e.g., `NCD!AA137` `=AA23+AA15+AA31+AA39+AA47+AA55+AA63`, `TL!N221` `=N218+N219-N220`), the true mathematical value is 0, and the input and golden workbooks merely hold different ~1e-13 to 1e-16 floating-point noise from different save passes in LibreOffice 7.3.7.2. Because `_within_tolerance` in `spreadsheetbench2.py` checks `abs(v1 - v2) / max(abs(v1), abs(v2)) <= 0.01` BEFORE `_transform_value` rounds floats to 2 decimal places, two tiny floating-point residuals around 1e-14 fail the relative check. Worse, when `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` recalculates `gt_14_Refinery_golden.xlsx` itself in the container's LibreOffice, it scores `0.0` (`FAILED - regression 1.0000, modification 0.9567. 97 cell error(s): Modification error at NCD!AA137: answer=-3.37507799486048e-13, output=-3.80140363631654e-13...`), and a submission built from the staged input workbook with all 13 exact golden formulas suffers 648 cell errors across `NCD` (97) and `TL` (551), capping `mod_ratio` at 0.7603 and scoring `0.0`.
confirmation: NCD!AA137 =AA23+...+AA63 is ~0 but cached 1.07e-14 in the input and -3.38e-13 in the golden, which makes it a 'modification' cell. _within_tolerance compares abs diff / max(abs) <= 0.01 before any rounding, so recalculation noise in untouched sheets fails the all-or-nothing check (run errors 672-684
fix: files/gt/gt_14_Refinery_golden.xlsx: set the cached value of 4,657 formula cells whose cached value was floating-point residue (0 < |v| < 1e-9; NCD 1,981, TL 2,674, Cash Flow F48/H48) to exactly 0. Formulas and every other cell unchanged. The verifier's 1% relative test then becomes an absolute 0.01 test on these cells, so recalculation noise no longer fails. Local check: patched GT scores PASS against itself after the verifier's forced LibreOffice recalc

title: Golden Sensitivity Analysis table in DCF_Income Approach!K27:O31 contains constant base-case Equity Value in all 25 cells
evidence: The prompt instructs: 'In the DCF_Income Approach sheet, calculate Equity Value, then create a Sensitivity Analysis table linking Equity Value to the pre-defined Terminal Growth Rate and WACC ranges.' In `gt_14_Refinery_golden.xlsx`, `DCF_Income Approach!J26` is set to `=D29` (`28810.1725164556`), and all 25 cells of the Sensitivity Analysis grid `K27:O31` contain `=TABLE($J$26,$C$18,$J27,$C$21,K$26)` with the identical cached base-case value `28810.1725164556` in every cell (a known LibreOffice Multiple Operations bug where re-saving writes the base-case value into every interior cell of the table). Furthermore, `recalculate_xlsx` calls `freeze_datatable_formulas` before running LibreOffice, stripping `TABLE(...)` formulas so they are never evaluated. As a result, Unit 3, which computed genuine two-dimensional sensitivity values across the WACC and Terminal Growth Rate grid (`K27=28416.09`, `K28=30013.54`, `K29=31774.87`, `K30=33726.66`, `K31=35901.58`), was marked wrong on 24 of the 25 grid cells against the constant golden value `28810.1725164556`.
confirmation: Golden K27:O31 all cache 28810.1725164556 although the axes vary (K26:O26 WACC 11.75%-13.75%, J27:J31 growth 1%-3%). Trial vzMyvUC's genuine grid (K27=28416.09, K28=30013.54) was marked wrong against that constant.
fix: files/gt/gt_14_Refinery_golden.xlsx: replaced the 25 cached values of 'DCF_Income Approach'!K27:O31 (all 28810.17) with the true two-way sensitivity of Equity Value (D29) to terminal growth J27:J31 (into C18) and WACC K26:O26 (into C21), recomputed from the golden's own DCF rows (e.g. K27 28145.76, M29 25520.12, O31 23049.35; base case reproduces 28810.17). TABLE formulas kept

title: GT sensitivity table is flat: all 25 cells equal the base Equity Value, so a correct sensitivity grid fails
evidence: In the GT, DCF_Income Approach K27:O31 hold '=TABLE($J$26,$C$18,$J27,$C$21,K$26)' (an Excel data table), and every cached value is 28810.1725164556. The WACC headers run 11.75%–13.75% (K26:O26) and the terminal growth rows run 1%–3% (J27:J31), yet every cell returns the same value. A real sensitivity grid must vary, because the terminal value L19 '=L17/(C21-C18)' depends directly on both inputs. LibreOffice does not evaluate TABLE(): when I left the TABLE formulas in place, the recalculated output gave None in all 25 cells ('Modification error at DCF_Income Approach!K27: answer=28810.1725164556, output=None'). The only way to pass these 25 modification cells is to hardcode the wrong constant 28,810 in every cell. Explicit formulas giving the correct equity value at each WACC/g pair fail.
confirmation: Golden 'DCF_Income Approach'!K27:O31 are =TABLE($26,$C$18,$J27,$C$21,K$26), all cached 28810.1725164556 across varying WACC and growth headers. A correct varying grid fails, as trial vzMyvUC shows (K27 28416.09 vs 28810.17).
fix: files/gt/gt_14_Refinery_golden.xlsx: replaced the 25 cached values of 'DCF_Income Approach'!K27:O31 (all 28810.17) with the true two-way sensitivity of Equity Value (D29) to terminal growth J27:J31 (into C18) and WACC K26:O26 (into C21), recomputed from the golden's own DCF rows (e.g. K27 28145.76, M29 25520.12, O31 23049.35; base case reproduces 28810.17). TABLE formulas kept

title: The sensitivity-analysis answer key contains the same base-case value in every scenario
evidence: In the golden workbook, 'DCF_Income Approach'!K27:O31 contains 28810.1725164556 in all 25 cells, despite different terminal-growth and WACC inputs. Recomputing from the golden workbook's own cash flows and terminal-value formulas reproduces its base equity value, but gives 25520.1236400487 for M29's 2% growth and 12.7476192037865% WACC, rather than 28810.1725164556. O31 should similarly be approximately 23049.3453059650. The sole verifier has weight 1 and requires every modification cell to match within its tolerance; a mathematically correct sensitivity table therefore fails the entire check.
confirmation: Same flat-grid defect: all 25 golden K27:O31 values equal the base equity value 28810.17, even though the terminal value depends on both C18 and C21. Correct sensitivity values are marked wrong under the all-or-nothing check.

title: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check: verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells is a trivial fail (cannot pass even on the ground-truth workbook itself)
evidence: Running `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` on the ground-truth file `gt_14_Refinery_golden.xlsx` itself returns `score=0.0` (`FAILED - regression 1.0000, modification 0.9567. 97 cell error(s): Modification error at NCD!AA137: answer=-3.37507799486048e-13, output=-3.80140363631654e-13...`). Furthermore, applying the exact 13 ground-truth formula edits to the staged input workbook `/home/model/Desktop/14_02_Refinery_input.xlsx` and running the verifier produces 648 cell errors across the untouched sheets `NCD` (97 modification errors) and `TL` (440 modification errors and 111 regression errors), all on floating-point zero residuals (~1e-13 to 1e-16), capping `mod_ratio` at `0.7603` (`score=0.0`). In the 3 production runs, Units 1, 2, and 3 all completed the depreciation roll-forward, WACC, and DCF Equity Value calculations, and their error counts (678, 684, and 672) consist of those same 648 unavoidable `NCD`/`TL` floating-point residual errors plus 24–36 cells on `DCF_Income Approach` (where the golden sensitivity table `K27:O31` also erroneously repeats the base-case value `28810.1725164556` in all 25 cells). Because `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` requires `mod_ratio == 1.0` to return `1.0` (otherwise `0.0`), no submission—not even the golden workbook—can ever score above `0.0`.
confirmation: Golden NCD!AA137 (true value 0) caches -3.375e-13 against input 1.07e-14. spreadsheetbench2.py _within_tolerance applies a relative 1% test to raw floats, so such residues mismatch. Golden 'DCF_Income Approach'!K27:O31 is a flat 28810.17, and all 3 trials scored 0 at modification ~0.75 with 672-684
